dct_description_sm: This project undertakes the core seabed mapping component of the Government of Nunavut research program. Underway acoustic mapping of the seabed relief, sediment distribution and shallow subsurface sediments are the prime datasets used by researchers to understand the geological processes shaping the seafloor, to assess natural hazards and coastal habitats and to reconstruct the history of past climatic changes. These mapping results are applied to specific projects including : Fisheries development, Opening new shipping lanes and improving navigational charting, Past to present evolution of sea-level history.
dct_title_s: 2013 Multibeam Sonar Data collected from the MV Nuliajuk
